dataList.content:
After we defeated the horde of gnomes...
战斗暂告一段落。

Don Quixote and Heathcliff fell to their knees before everyone.
堂吉诃德和希斯克利夫正襟危坐在众人面前。

I also knelt down, feeling like I should be down there with them... but Outis tightly pulled me to the side.
我也觉得或许有必要加入其中，于是悄悄弯下腰，但奥提斯坚决地拉着我到一边……

<Mm... I feel bad for those two.>
<呜……总感觉对不起那两个人。>

... I am ready... Commence, Lady Outis...
……已经准备好了……开始吧……奥提斯女士……

You absolute buffoons... How did you ever think that this was going to turn out okay?
你们……究竟是做了什么事情才会有这样的想法？

Are you even aware of the risks Executive Manager took to get here? How worried they were about you two?!
你知不知道经理有多么担心你们，忍受了多少危险！

Well, actually, Clockhead was in on it from the sta—
事实上，钟表头也想要这样做……

Silence!
吵死了！

Do not refer to the Executive Manager with such derogatory language! Insolent fool!
不要那样叫经理的名字！真是没礼貌的家伙！

Heeaugh! 'Twas mine fault! 'Twas mine fault!
啊，非常抱歉，非常抱歉！

My mother used to scold me like this in my youth.
这就像小时候被妈妈训斥时的场景一样。

Outis did not seem to slow down at all with her stern scoldings...
奥提斯的训斥似乎没有停下的迹象……

And the pair fell completely silent, their heads hung low.
两人似乎已经感到压力，从刚才开始一直低着头默不作声。

... I decided to wander away from this scene. This guilty conscience was too much for me to bear.
我……感觉到良心有一些刺痛，所以决定去看看其他地方。

<... Is Crayon doing okay...?>
<柯蕾昂小姐还好吗……？>

Yes. She merely lost her consciousness from exposure to excessive degree of psychological shock.
是的。只是因为过度的精神冲击暂时昏迷了。

How did you find yourself at a place such as this?
你是怎么被带到这个地方的？

You are... a human, right? And we're really in the Outskirts?
人类……对吧？这里确实是郊区吧？

Crayon initially appeared somewhat taken back from the deluge of questions. But she soon began to open up.
柯蕾昂似乎被一连串的问题吓了一跳。但随后她缓缓开口道。

So... you're really from the City.
果然……大家都是都市里的人吧。
dataList.title:
???
？？？

dataList.content:
I'm from Cloud Town. It's a village on the north side of the Outskirts.
我是在郊区北部的小镇……云之镇的居民。

Are there a lot of... monsters like those gnomes out here? That can speak?
在郊区那种……像小矮人一样的怪物很多吗？会说人类语言的？

Yeah. There are many more monsters out here other than the gnomes. I've seen a few of them myself, but... the village elders told me about the rest.
是的。除了小矮人之外……这里还有更多的怪物。我自己见过了其中的一些，但镇里的大人们告诉我的更多。

Our village was built to keep the monsters out. To keep us safe.
我们的镇子是为了防御那些怪物而建造的。为了保证我们的安全。

If this didn't happen... we'd all be preparing dinner back at the village by now...
如果这一切没有发生……我们现在已经在小镇里准备晚餐了……

So they raided your village.
所以它们袭击了你们的镇子。

Yeah... and they attacked us when the Hunters were gone. So...
是的……偏偏是在猎人离开的时候……

We normally don't get raided by them around this time of year, so I thought we were safe... But they suddenly attacked us, rushing in on their sleighs...
它们通常不会在每年的这个时候袭击我们……所以我认为我们很安全……但是它们突然骑着雪橇冲了进来向我们发动了攻击……

Some of us tried to fight, but we didn't stand a chance. And... everyone that they killed... got shoved into the sacks on that sleigh.
有的人试着抵抗，但我们根本不是它们的对手……很多人死了。被它们杀死的人……都被塞进了雪橇上的袋子里。

I passed out from fright... and they thought I was dead, too. I got shoved into the sacks like the rest of the villagers.
我吓得昏了过去……它们以为我也死了，就把我和其他镇民一样塞进了袋子里。

Oh... We forced you to talk about something that couldn't have been easy to go through. I'm sorry.
啊……抱歉，让你回想起那些不好的事情。

N-no, it's okay... Can I... ask things, too?
没、没关系……我能……问些事吗？

Anything.
当然可以。

Is it right that crayon boxes in the City have 48 different colors? And they have gold and silver colored crayons, too?
都市里有48种颜色的蜡笔是真的吗？连金色和银色的也有？

Um... Probably...
唔……大概……

And...
还有……

... there's just people in the City, right? No... monsters like the gnomes that try to kill us, right?
在都市里……只住着人类吧？像这样……会杀掉我们的怪物是不存在的吧！

Hmm... It's kinda hard to answer that, actually.
嗯……这是一个十分复杂的问题。

Sometimes, I'd climb a high hill to look at the City. I always saw pretty, colorful lights from up there... So colorful that I don't have enough colors in my crayon box to draw them all.
我爬到高处时偶尔可以远远看到，都市里充满了超~级美丽的光芒。那是以我现有的颜色无法描绘的绚丽色彩。

I wish I could live in the City. If I lived there, I'd never have to worry about getting attacked by monsters. I could live happily with all my neighbors...
好羡慕啊。大家不用担心什么时候会被怪物杀掉，可以和邻居们一起幸福地生活……

... You've really never been to the City, huh.
你真的，从来没去过都市啊。

S.S.E.
此·此。

I'm sorry...?
嗯……？

Same story everywhere. Doesn't matter where you are. Death always stalks us.
此处彼处，此间彼间，皆同死亡相邻。

Woah... that was so cool! Can you say that again?
哇……好帅……请再说一次！

<Huh? That was cool...?>
<诶？帅……？>

... Oh! Uh, did you guys see anyone else nearby, by any chance?
……啊！还有，在附近有看到其他人吗？

I don't think we ran into any other humans out here.
我不记得有在这里见过其他人。

No... But he has to be here to save us...
不会吧……他肯定会来救我们的……

Who do you mean?
是在说哪一位的事情？

The best Hunter of Cloud Town... If he was at the village, the gnomes wouldn't have...
是我们云之镇最好的猎人……要是那位在的话这回的袭击也……

It appears that, in the Outskirts, there are 'Hunters' who specialize in hunting monsters. Akin to Whalers of the Great Lake, that is.
从言语中推测，是和大湖的捕鲸人一般的在郊区专门狩猎怪物的猎人。

But... Wait.
但是……等下。

So if they're kidnapping and killing humans for these gifts...
之前说过是抓来人类制作……这些礼物的吧。

... Who are these gifts for?
……那这些礼物是为了送给谁而制作的？

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
HO! HO! HO!
嚯！嚯！嚯！

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Of course, the gifts are for our poor and kind neighbors who do not cry!
当然，那是为了送给可怜、温柔又不会哭泣的我等的邻居！

Executive Manager! Retreat!
执行经理！退后！

I don't know when it happened... but a large shadow was looming over us.
在察觉到之前，从我们背后探出了巨大的影子。

Augh! What is that thing?!
呜啊，吓死我了！那是什么？！

I am Santata, bringer of gifts to our neighbors! HO! HO! HO!
老夫是把礼物分给邻居的桑塔塔，嚯！嚯！嚯！

The guffawing giant, garbed in red, carried a massive gift sack on his shoulder.
身材魁梧的巨人穿着红色的衣服，肩上扛着比我还要大的礼物袋，正狞笑着。

It was definitely not a human.
的确，不是人类。

Yeah! It's that git! That one's the boss!
是的！就是那家伙！那家伙就是这里的老大！

Lo! The crimson garb! That is the crimson garb that I spoke of!
那件衣服！是那件衣服！那件红色的衣服就是吾等所探寻的……

The pair immediately jumped up from their knees and began shouting in unison.
正坐着的两位罪人也像事前商量好一般，同时站了起来大叫道。

That's the Red Sack's outfit? Oi, then he's already...
那不是收尾人冬红布袋的衣服吗……？啊，那他已经……

N-no! Not the Reindeer-man, too!
不、不要……别连驯鹿人都！

Shut it! Cut the useless chatter, for once...
闭嘴！别再说闲话了……

After silencing the pair with a short, stern command, Outis approached me and spoke in a low voice.
奥提斯打断了那两人的对话，然后低声对我说道。

Executive Manager. Since he appears to be of an intelligent species, I will attempt to parlay with it. ... But we best prepare for battle in case the talks fall through.
执行经理。既然它看起来像是知性体，那么我会尝试着与它对话……不过，我们也要做好谈判破裂的战斗准备。

<... Yeah, that's a good idea.>
<……嗯，好主意。>

What do you mean by neighbors...? Wings? Clients from the City?
你说邻居……是指谁？都市里的翼或者客户吗？

HO! HO! HO! But we are denied entry to the City, are we not?
嚯！嚯！嚯！你以为我们能够进入都市吗？

Is that big lump of meat a gnome, too...?
那一大坨的也算是小矮人吗……？

I happened to overhear the gnomes during our time in captivity... They call their master 'Beard Giant', which I believe is not a gnome.
之前吾偷听到了那些小矮人们的谈话……这里的老板似乎被叫作大胡子巨人，而非小矮人。

A giant...? There really are all kinds of monsters out here, huh.
还有巨人……这里真是什么怪物都有啊。

Dante, that's not an Abnormality, is it?
但丁，那不是异想体吧？

<No. That's not an Abnormality or a Distortion. I'd say it's closer to the Whales...>
<不，那既不是异想体也不是扭曲。它反倒更像那些鲸……>

HO! HO! Do you yearn for gifts, too? Yet your kind already owns all there is to own!
嚯！嚯！你们也盼着得到礼物吗？可你们不是什么都有吗？

We and our neighbors in the Outskirts wish so dearly for that very day. The only day we are allowed joy and comfort in human gifts.
我与这郊区的邻居们日夜盼望着这一日。我们收到由人类制成的礼物，在这一天享受欢乐与安宁。

I see. You produce toys out of humans and gift them to those who harbor hatred for humans.
用人类制成玩具，再赠送给那些憎恨人类的存在吗。

Out of the pure goodness of your heart.
纯粹出于善意。

Here, where all those who have been marginalized and exiled by humans gather and wallow...
被人类所放逐驱赶的我们，都生活在这里……

... we pour our infinite hatred and care into packaging these gifts. HO! HO! HO!
因此我们以无限的仇恨，精心地包装着这些礼物。嚯！嚯！嚯！

Quite the verbose way of saying 'I refuse to negotiate'.
对于“谈判破裂”来说这番话还真啰嗦啊。

HO! HO! HO! Why don't you come here and join us, become joy to those who need it?
嚯！嚯！嚯！你们不想为他们带来快乐吗，为什么不来成为我们的礼物呢？
